comparison.objective: Transfer eleven nuts while keeping a mechanical tally synchronized.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated small-part pick/place coordinated with counter reset and button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: All nuts rest in the tray, counter reads 0011 after a valid zero, parts and mechanism are settled, and no nut was dropped.
comparison.reason: The defining challenge is action-count synchronization across repeated transfers, absent from damper commissioning.
